control-size.value: One size for every field and toggle in these surfaces: `h-9`, `text-sm` (the primitives' default), with no per-site overrides.

text-tokens.value: Add rem-based tokens (`text-2xs` = 0.6875rem, `text-3xs` = 0.625rem) in `tailwind.config.js` and use them in the in-scope files, so helper text follows Cmd+/−. The other ~490 app-wide `text-[11px]` uses are **out of scope** (a separate sweep).

isolate-control.value: Replace the native checkbox with the hand-rolled `Switch` (as Max Mode uses), label associated, `data-testid="isolate-toggle"` kept.

dialog-parts.value: Add `DialogHeader` / `DialogTitle` / `DialogDescription` / `DialogBody` / `DialogFooter` to `ui/dialog.tsx` and adopt them in the in-scope dialogs. Other dialogs adopt them later, when touched.

cmd-enter.value: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter triggers **Run task** in the panel and the dialogs (shown as a hint on the button). It is inert while a popover or autocomplete is open, and it does nothing when Run is disabled.

header-version.value: Remove the raw CLI `--version` text from the panel header; the version stays in the harness picker's row tooltip.

e2e-churn.value: Update the ~15 affected specs in the same change. Move DOM-path XPath locators (Model/Effort/Mode) to stable test ids (`new-task-*` / `launch-*` unify to one prefix, e.g. `launch-model-picker`). Keep the accessible names that the e2e asserts unless a decision above renames them.

sidebar-stays.value: The panel stays a left sidebar: always mounted, collapsible to its rail, an aside-wide drop zone, the onboarding spotlight target. The Branch summary row becomes a visibly clickable row, and "Reset to pattern" and "Change" become small ghost buttons.
